reproduced_defect.behavior: after more than 32 completed requests, the oldest request fingerprint was forgotten and replay() returned miss, allowing a future server path to call the provider again

candidate_v2.filter_semantics: Bloom-style fail-closed membership: false positives may reject a novel request, but a recorded old request is not forgotten when it falls out of the recent exact list
candidate_v2.legacy_candidate_compatibility: on load, an older replay record without the filter seeds it from its surviving recent exact fingerprints

limits: the filter is deliberately fail-closed and can produce false positives after very large numbers of historical requests; this is an availability tradeoff, not a replay-safety false negative
server exact-context integration remains the next step
native Windows semantics remain unproven and no hosted CI was started
